notes: The waw of וְאֵיךְ נֹאמַר אֵלָיו is the conjunction of the clause the ASV renders 'if we tell him that the child is dead'; under rules 14 and 55 a waw standing in the clause takes the subordinator the ASV writes for it (corpus: waw → 'if' in 22 units), so 'if' goes to s041 rather than being added beside an unrepresented waw.
